page_title: Fuad I gold Service Medal AH 1347 (1928/9)
working_name_zh: 福阿德一世恩典奖章／仁惠奖章
english_name: Grace and Favour Medal / Service Medal
notes: Catalogue text explicitly identifies the piece as a first-class Grace and Favour medal for 35 years of service. Obverse is Fuad I in military attire; reverse bears crowned mantled arms within an oak wreath. Silver and bronze classes are mentioned but not illustrated in this lot.
